reviews.title: just why abcmouse
reviews.text: I downloaded this god forsaken app for my childREAN, but it completely failed to teach important daily life skills like pouring water and drinking from a cup correctly. Instead of educational content, the 3D mouse mascot keeps dancing and twerking against a plain white background like he's in that weird SpongeBob Sponge Out of Water movie trailer, like IM DEAD SERIOUS. I don't recommend this for actual learning and 4D characters viewing, but the goofy high-fiving rodent gets it a two-star.

reviews.title: Didn’t like it, difficult to cancel.
reviews.text: The games weren’t worth it, and canceling was a nightmare. The website made me download the app, the app logged me into the wrong account, then just redirected me back to a website anyway. The cancel button was tiny and buried behind multiple pages. Canceling a subscription shouldn’t be this difficult they make too many hoops instead of being direct, they need to make their games better, just too much out there these days with better games.

reviews.title: ABC mouse app
reviews.text:
We use the Apple iPad for ABC mouse! My daughter is Autistic and homeschooling during our breaks she gets on ABC Mouse and plays while also learning! She loves the High five the mouse when you open the app. It’s one of her favorite parts. It’s very child friendly. I agree with the teaching they have on there! 
The only part I do not like as much is the reading the books. She skips through it fast but they have each word lit up as they read it. So I have to slow her down during that part. Other than that small part I do not like—I really recommend to all parents to get this app especially during the summer so kids don’t fall behind! Thank you ABC Mouse!

reviews.title: Billing beware
reviews.text: Not the first time this has happened. Kid downloads an app and idiot parent decides to allow a free app only to be charged $17 a month auto billing. Tried to cancel twice and ask for a refund after the first time and deleted the app but they will not refund. This time I saved the screenshot and email if my cancellation along with the transcript of my conversation with customer no service.

reviews.title: Upgrade or unusable
reviews.text: Despite the app saying you can use the basic version, we keep having a page pop up asking us to sign up for a free trial. We don’t want to because we don’t want to pay so the trial is pointless. We were happy with basic but there’s no way to continue with it. So don’t waste your time downloading this app unless you intend to upgrade.

reviews.title: Super Glitchy!
reviews.text: It worked fine whenever we first downloaded it. But after a few weeks, it’s become very glitchy. The app is up to date and it often freezes or there’s no sound. I had to download the older ABC mouse app, and it works fine. Hope there’s an update soon to fix the bugs!!

reviews.title: Just okay, contains mistakes
reviews.text: This is definitely educational but contains too many mistakes for the price that they are asking for it. It keeps asking my kid to “Show What You Know” and then asks questions about stories that she has never read. The Farm Bridge Builder game told her to click on a number, but she needed to click letters, not numbers. Sometimes the audio does not match what is written on screen when reading the title of a game. Also, it keeps encouraging her to spend her tickets as quickly as she earns them, which I feel is not a good lesson for finances.

reviews.title: Overcharged no refunds
reviews.text:
I canceled my subscription and they offered a yearly deal of 30$ so I did that. I was just charged their monthly rate... account went negative and got charged 30$ from my bank. This is a month after I bought their year subscription.
Kids also don't care for it. They like Lingokids better.

reviews.title: Predatory app
reviews.text:
I barely used this app to be honest. However, I cannot understate how predatory this app is with its subscriptions. Firstly, they offer an annual price like most others, but immediately after navigating that prompt your given another prompt for something that looks exactly the same but is a separate annual charge.

Then if you want to cancel your subscription, you have to download the app, sign in, put in a BIRTHDATE THAT SUPPOSEDLY ISNT TRACKED . Then sent to a web browser that only has email reset, password reset, or support.


I should be able to cancel my subscription from here but I can’t. 

Bad app, bad web design, bad practices.
